args.evidence: raw.orders has 16200 rows but only 15000 distinct o_orderkey, showing 1200 duplicate rows. Sample duplicate key 1216 appears twice with identical column values. stg_orders simply selects from raw.orders, so duplicates flow downstream, causing unique_stg_orders_order_key check to fail with 1200 duplicates. Identical duplicates indicate batch delivered twice; policy: deduplicate in staging model (patch).
